svg.title: Chordity — Find the harmony.
svg.desc: Original illustrative artwork, not an application screenshot. Four-note block chords press simultaneously on every quarter-note beat in 4/4 at 120 BPM. One different chord per beat: C major seventh, A dominant seventh, D minor seventh, then G dominant seventh. The four-beat progression repeats every two seconds. Reduced motion shows a still C major seventh chord. Yeony creative tools.
